title: observability-token-level-cost-latency-logging-dashboard-alert-tuning
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds token-level cost/latency breakdowns to observability dashboards, enhances KV cache logging and tracing, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce false positives for NRT workloads.
description: Context: teams have been seeing increased noise from token-level cost and latency alerts and incomplete KV cache logs that make post-incident analysis slow. This PR extends token-level metrics, improves KV cache logging for correlating misses/hits with request traces, and updates dashboard panels and alert thresholds to match recent load characteristics. Summary of changes: 1) Export per-token cost and latency histograms with percentile buckets and per-model labels; 2) Add KV cache diagnostic logs that include truncated request prefixes and cache keys for correlation (PII-scrubbed); 3) Wire token-level metrics into the existing Grafana dashboards and Datadog integrations; 4) Introduce noise-resistant alert tuning: separate high-latency short-tail alerts from high-cost sustained alerts, add a cooldown window and dynamic thresholds based on 95th percentile baseline; 5) Add traces that link token emission to KV cache lifecycle events for end-to-end latency analysis; 6) Small SDK telemetry changes to surface token counts for streaming calls. Checklist: [x] unit + integration tests updated [x] load-tested at 2x baseline for 1 hour [x] privacy review for added logs [x] Linear tickets linked || Motivation: reduce oncall churn and improve incident MTTR by providing higher-fidelity signals and fewer false positives. Rollout plan: staged feature flag rollout to 10% -> 50% -> 100% of traffic with canary dashboards and gated alert enablement. Backout: revert feature flag and dashboards if alerting regressions occur.

review_comments: Liam Chen: Please confirm that kv cache logs are scrubbed for PII and that flagging is off by default in prod. Also suggest adding a size limit to logged prefixes to avoid large payloads.
Asha Patel: kv cache logs include a redaction step and a size cap of 256 bytes for prefixes; flag is off by default. Added unit tests for redaction logic.
Sofia Martinez: Alert tuning looks reasonable but can we run an A/B canary to validate false positive reduction? Recommend adding a metric that counts alert-triggering samples to measure reduction.
Asha Patel: Added alert_trigger_count metric and dashboard panel for canary evaluation. Plan: canary for 48h then evaluate.
Rajiv Kapoor: Minor nit: move dynamic threshold helper to common/observability so other teams can reuse. Also please sync with infra team on terraform changes.
Asha Patel: Moved helper and added documentation in services/telemetry/README.md. Notified infra in #infra-observability; terraform changes use a feature-flagged module.
